field_principles.compounding_delta_ci95: Bootstrap CI95 of the final-minus-initial held-out first-error F1 -- excluding 0 is the decision-grade compounding signal.
field_principles.fallback_to_ensemble: BARE bool: true iff exp4392 built no localizer and this task fell back to the ensemble-detector localization-compounding reading -- records the measurement target honestly.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. A win (the localizer COMPOUNDS -- held-out first-error F1 rises with data beyond the no-learning baseline) and a CLEAN null (saturates early, positive control confirms) are BOTH decision-grade.
field_principles.learning_curve: list of {train_corpus_size, held_out_localization_f1} -- the compounding curve (the exp4364/4385 discipline, on the localizer where headroom is real).
field_principles.localizer_compounds: BARE bool: the capstone reads this (gated-fields-must-be-bare); true iff held-out first-error localization-F1 rises with accumulated-corpus size BEYOND the no-learning baseline (delta CI95-excl-0) AND the positive control confirms non-trivial headroom -- the live localizer vehicle self-improving with data.
field_principles.model_specs: The verifier ensemble + the localizer + the corpus + the train/held-out split + the no-learning + positive-control baselines + n; required methodology.
field_principles.no_learning_baseline: BARE float: the .405 ensemble-detector localization F1 (0.096) -- the floor the learning curve must beat to count as compounding.
field_principles.positive_control_passed: BARE bool: true iff the from-scratch full-corpus localizer (the ceiling) confirms non-trivial headroom -- so a flat curve is honest saturation, not a no-op mechanism (FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISK guard).
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records the localizer + corpus + ensemble + TRM-stand-down verified; pre-empts the silent-missing-resource fabrication mode.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism precondition for the corpus split + the localizer fitting + the bootstrap.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash of the corpus split + the fitted localizers + the learning curve; lets a third party re-run.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: BARE bool=false -- the localizer is a learned/energy signal, oracle-distinct.

methodology_note: CPU-only cached localizer fitting. The train stream combines deterministic Exp 4392 synthetic process traces with cached real FoVer step labels. No TRM training or live LLM generation is invoked.

preconditions_checked.detail: not invoked; localizer fitting against cached labeled traces only
